entities.name: Emancipation Proclamation
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Executive order issued by President Lincoln on 1 January 1863, declaring slaves in Confederate states "forever free." While limited in immediate scope, it transformed the Civil War into a fight for human freedom and paved the way for the 13th Amendment.
